checks.name: Dependency-ordered local migrations compile without production bootstrap data
Wrong password is rejected and submit recovers
Real Auth login and PostgREST profile/RBAC load show empty real dashboard
Warehouse and product forms persist to actual PostgreSQL
Inventory form changes durable stock, not a local counter
Order form atomically writes order/items/delivery and reserves stock
Lead creation and call outcome forms persist actual customer numbers
Reload preserves actual records and ignores legacy demo localStorage
Delivery and cashflow forms update server-calculated dashboard
Permission revocation is enforced by PostgREST/RPC despite stale UI grants
Logout removes authorized shell and private client state
Password recovery email stays in Mailpit and reset completes through real Auth
No unhandled browser error or backend mutation mock
